clauses.quote: DCPS shall post on its website copies of all position descriptions, when available.
To further facilitate the placement of excessed Teachers, DCPS shall provide multiple hiring opportunities (e.g., hiring fairs and other similar activities).
Excessed permanent status Teachers shall have sixty (60) calendar days following the effective date of the excess to secure another placement in DCPS under mutual consent.

An excessed permanent status Teacher who is unable to secure a new placement within the sixty (60) calendar days following the effective date of the excess shall have five (5) calendar days immediately following expiration of the sixty (60) calendar day period to select one (1) of the following options.
clauses.subject_text: An excessed permanent status Teacher who is unable to secure a new placement within the sixty (60) calendar days following the effective date of the excess

clauses.quote: Any Teacher who does not make a selection shall be subject to separation from DCPS on the 66th calendar day following the effective date of the excess.
clauses.subject_text: Any Teacher who does not make a selection
clauses.notes: Condition of non-selection triggers mandatory separation.

clauses.quote: Excessed permanent status Teachers shall have the option to receive a $25,000 cash buyout resulting in separation from DCPS.
An excessed permanent status Teacher who opts for the buyout shall not be eligible for employment with DCPS for a period of three (3) years.
clauses.subject_text: An excessed permanent status Teacher who opts for the buyout

clauses.quote: Excessed permanent status Teachers with twenty (20) or more years of creditable service shall have the option of retiring with full benefits.
clauses.subject_text: Excessed permanent status Teachers with twenty (20) or more years of creditable service
